title: Carraig Na Greine, Furbo, Co. Galway, H91FY2P
seoTitle: Carraig Na Greine, Furbo, Co. Galway, H91FY2P
description:
O’Donnellan & Joyce Auctioneers are privileged to bring for sale this magnificent coastal residence with uninterrupted panoramic views over Galway Bay and out to the Atlantic Ocean. 

Carraig na Greine is a spacious detached residence on a substantial and beautifully landscaped site, just on the Coast Road in the Furbo locale of Co. Galway. 

The home boasts stunning views over Galway Bay towards the Burren in County Clare and on to the Aran Islands.  

Originally constructed in 1993, the property has been well maintained over the years and offers an abundance of living space with approximately 158.5 sq.m throughout. 

Arranged over one level, the accommodation consists of four sizeable bedrooms, all suitable for double beds, en-suite bathroom and Jack-&-Jill bathroom. 

The sitting room to the front of the home avails of plentiful natural light, you can enjoy spectacular sunrises and sunsets from the sitting room, porch and bedrooms to the front of the house, along with stunning views, whilst a spacious open-plan reception-dining-kitchen area is positioned at the rear of the home. A separate utility space completes the property’s accommodation. 

An excellent addition to the home is the attic space and the further potential it offers. Currently accessible via a Stira loft ladder in the hallway, the large attic space covers the majority of the property. The mostly floored area consists of high ceilings and dormer windows already in place.  It offers excellent storage as is and has current planning permission for conversion to residential use further availing of the spectular Galway Bay Views.

A key feature of the residence is the outside space on offer. Positioned on approximately 0.84 acres, the property is encompassed by landscaped greenery as well as a large tarmacadam drive wrapping around the entire house, offering ample parking. 

Mature hedging along the front boundary gives good privacy to the home, whilst the elevated position of the site still allows the grounds to take advantage natural light throughout the day as well as the scenic surroundings. 

A solid outbuilding is separate to the property which offers further storage, workspace or potential for a home office.

Carraig na Greine is an idyllic setting in a popular and sought-after coastal location of Co. Galway. Situated between Furbo and Barna villages along the Connemara Coast Road, the property is ideally located for peaceful rural tranquility whilst still having easy access to Galway City.  

Local amenities and quality schools are within easy reach in nearby Furbo, Spiddal and Barna making the property ideal for family living. 

Regular public transport links and quality road networks give easy access to Galway City, whilst picturesque Connemara is on the home’s doorstep giving the best of both worlds. 

Carraig na Greine is an ideal residence for any purchaser seeking enviable views on a beautiful elevated site. 

The house is in quality condition as is but offers excellent potential to further create a magnificent family home.  

There are several beaches nearby along the Galway Bay coastline.  

Viewing is highly recommended and guaranteed not to disappoint.
